value.residual: The Aeneas extraction of norm_precedence/decision.rs (admits, resolution_holds) is proved sound against NornSem.Norm for every input (acceptance only when the order is admissible with an exact closure certificate, and only when the resolution is the unique stable set), and the precedence meta-theorems hold for every admitted order (#718 U3/U4). Completeness (every admissible order with the exact closure is admitted, and the true resolution is accepted) is not proved: it is property-tested against the former whole-set oracle (core_decides_exactly_as_the_whole_set_query) on groundings of at most 5 norms and 3 contexts. No implementation_proved claim is made (#969). The grounding, the closure and resolution search, the explainer and every other checker family remain outside it (TRUST-NORM-PRECEDENCE-SHELL).
